security_spec.violation_condition: Kernel code iterates xiselect over the old inclusive upper bound [0x1000, 0x1100] instead of the corrected [0x1000, 0x10FF], causing a CSR access at xiselect=0x1100 to an undefined indirect register slot, which triggers an illegal instruction exception in supervisor mode.
security_spec.summary: xiselect range off-by-one: kernel using old inclusive 0x1100 bound on corrected hardware causes illegal instruction trap in supervisor mode when accessing nonexistent acliciprio256/aclicsourcecfg512, crashing the kernel during interrupt context save/restore or KVM virtual interrupt delivery.
